about: Readability floors for a drawn stage at rest (backdrop and platforms, no actors, no interface). A zone passes when at least `floor` of its pixels give the stage's ink `contrast`:1 or better. Rectangles are x, y, width, height in the 1600x900 world frame. Read by tests/stage-readability.js; tests/unit/stage-art.test.ts requires every drawn stage to be listed in `stages`. Floors are only ever raised.
